_readme: Site library. lag_min = minutes the site's current turn lags behind the Malakal high/low (positive = later). strength_factor scales Malakal flow rate to the site's felt strength. All values start as estimates and are calibrated from dive_log.csv. Coordinates are approximate and only used to pick the weather grid point.

sites.name: Blue Corner / Blue Holes

incoming.entry: Drop upstream of the corner (Blue Holes side is the usual combined entry), drift onto the plateau and hook in at 18-25 m.
incoming.notes: Incoming usually gives the best shark action.

outgoing.entry: Current reverses along the wall: drop on the opposite side of the plateau from the incoming entry and drift back onto it. Confirm with the guide/captain.
outgoing.notes: Outgoing often still diveable here; rays and jacks more likely.

sites.slack: Quietest period; can enter from the plateau and explore slowly.
sites.hazards: Down-currents and current shifts mid-dive. Negative entry, reef hook, SMB.

sites.name: Siaes Corner

incoming.entry: Start on the upcurrent side of the corner and drift to the point; hook in on the plateau edge at 10-18 m.
incoming.notes: Incoming: strongest current, best visibility, grey reef shark schools.

outgoing.entry: Start on the other side of the corner (current reversed) and drift to the point.

sites.slack: Easy wall dive; less action at the corner.
sites.hazards: Fire coral and hydroids on the reef top. Flow on top can differ from flow on the wall.

sites.name: Ulong Channel

incoming.entry: Enter at the outer channel mouth (~20 m), hook in at the sandy run-off to watch sharks, then unhook and drift into the channel toward the lagoon.
incoming.notes: Classic Ulong dive. Clear ocean water.

outgoing.entry: Not the classic dive: lagoon water drains out and pushes divers toward open water. Usually choose another site or a sheltered option.

sites.slack: Current may reverse mid-dive near the turn. If it reverses, turn and go with it.
sites.hazards: Strong, changing currents. Titan triggerfish nests in season.

sites.name: German Channel

incoming.entry: Start at the southern (outer) mooring and drift into the channel toward the lagoon, past the manta cleaning station at 18-20 m. Finish at the northern mooring.
incoming.notes: Incoming: 20-40 m visibility, mantas often inside the shallow channel.

outgoing.entry: Outgoing pushes toward the ocean with murky lagoon water. Stay near the cleaning station on the outer mouth, or dive another site.

sites.slack: Good for waiting at the cleaning station.
sites.hazards: Boat traffic in the channel; shallow, fast water inside.
